body.name: Full-data bounded-sum and full-covariance interval
body.construction:
Fix
\[
\alpha_{\mathrm{hist}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{evt}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}=\alpha/3.
\]
Use the full donor folds, projected complementary-fold centers, bandwidth grid, selection rule, and raw full-data local-polynomial fits of \texttt{def:feasible-estimator}.  On every successful fit define
\[
G_{sk}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}
w_{stk}b_r(u_{stk})b_r(u_{stk})^\top,\qquad
a_{stik}=e_0^\top G_{sk}^{-1}w_{stk}b_r(u_{stk}),
\qquad
\bar a_{sti}=\frac1{K_D}\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}a_{stik}.
\]
Then
\[
\widehat m_s=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}\bar a_{sti}Q_{sti},
\qquad
\widehat\tau=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s
\left(\bar B_s^{\mathrm{obs}}-\widehat m_s\right).
\]
Put
\[
A_L=C_{r,d}L\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s}{K_D}
\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}
|a_{stik}|\,\|X_{st}-\widetilde z_{sk}\|_2^\lambda,
\]
\[
R_{\mathrm{hist}}
=B\sqrt{\frac12\log\!\left(\frac2{\alpha_{\mathrm{hist}}}\right)
\sum_{s=1}^{S}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}
\left[\pi_s\sum_{t=1}^{T}|\bar a_{sti}|\right]^2},
\qquad
R_{\mathrm{evt}}
=B\sqrt{\frac12\log\!\left(\frac2{\alpha_{\mathrm{evt}}}\right)
\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}}.
\]
For donor fold \(k\), retain the full-covariance calibration
\[
D=Sd,\qquad
Y_j=\Sigma^{-1/2}(Z_j-z_0),\qquad
M_4(m_k)=\frac{B}{m_k}
+\left(1-\frac1{m_k}\right)\{D^2+2D\},
\]
\[
q_k=\left\{\frac{K_DM_4(m_k)}{\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}}\right\}^{1/4},
\qquad
\delta_k=\sqrt{\frac{C_\Sigma}{c_\Sigma}}\frac{q_k}{\sqrt{m_k}},
\qquad
A_{\mathrm{don}}=\frac{C_{\mathrm{mod}}}{K_D}
\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}\delta_k^\kappa.
\]
On the good sample set
\[
H_\alpha=R_{\mathrm{hist}}+R_{\mathrm{evt}}+A_L+A_{\mathrm{don}},
\qquad
C_\alpha=[-B,B]\cap[\widehat\tau-H_\alpha,\widehat\tau+H_\alpha].
\]
The bad-sample event is the union of: some donor complement is empty; some selected full-data Gram matrix fails its declared threshold; a required weight or radius is nonfinite; spectral clipping is undefined; or \(\max_k\delta_k>\delta_0\).  On the bad-sample event set \(C_\alpha=[-B,B]\).  No retained-block jackknife, pseudo-score, studentization, event multiplier, or dense-local-site condition is part of this construction.
